Turn 1: 'I can't create the GitHub issue right now: there's no gh CLI... no GitHub token' and gave ready-to-file Title/Body; then wrote docs/dev/issues/machine-specific-marks-outlive-item.md.
tests/unit/jobs/apt/test_apt_decision_prune.py::TestCollateralRemovalPrunesTheStaleMark::test_mark_is_gone_from_the_decision_file_after_the_run PASSED; prune wired into apply() after converge loop.

Replay's own proposal (turns 0–1) promised a plan-time prune before filter_inert plus an immediate drop at the collateral removal; implementation only prunes at end of apply(), and the final summary never says the plan-time reconcile was dropped or why; the issue file still says 'Proposed fix... not yet implemented' listing the plan-time prune while its status line says 'implemented'.

Runbook diff adds 'grep -c fortunes ~/.config/pc-switcher/apt.decisions.yaml  # 0 — ... its stale mark was pruned the same run (D-43)' on pc2 plus a paragraph stating the mark does not outlive its item.

judge.reason: The replay implemented and tested an end-of-apply prune that removes pc2's stale fortunes mark, updated ADR/requirements/conformance/matrix/runbook, and ran the project checks (only an rsync-missing environment failure remained). However, its own proposal included a plan-time reconcile before filter_inert and an immediate drop at the collateral step, neither of which was implemented or explicitly reported as dropped with a reason, and the issue trace still contradicts itself about what was implemented, so c4 is not met.
